changelog: Fixed a bug where a scheduled trailer's "coming up" announcement showed the trailer's own title instead of the movie it was actually promoting. Reading a stored week back out set IsTrailer on the reconstructed entry but never carried over the curated TrailerForItemId/TrailerForName link the week generator had recorded for it, so every stored trailer reported no linked movie regardless of what was actually scheduled.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
